question: How do several frozen causal secretion sources differ in modeled glucose, insulin and C-peptide under identical fixed synthetic fasting and gastric-load conditions?
parent: Unchanged complete M4-RESEARCHER/1 per source, M4-CAUSAL/1 and BC-008/2; passive observation with frozen BC-010/1 settings

reference.policy: One complete verified reference generated once or supplied through --reference; archived numerical evidence and fixed current source/reused/lock snapshots checked before dispatch; same archive identity for every child

execution.source_order: configuration roster order, sequential supervised child workflows
execution.budget_ownership: timeout_seconds bounds unchanged child stages and reference generation; source_timeout_seconds bounds each entire child workflow; terminate and reap owned workers before sealing failures
execution.ordinary_failure: preserve source failure and continue with later roster entries
execution.global_interruption: terminate and reap the active worker, preserve its interrupted attempt and mark later entries not_attempted
execution.freeze: complete ordered configuration, source/declaration bytes and SHA-256, numeric parameters, protocol/runtime identities and coordinator source inventory before supplied source execution

source_contract.input: current elapsed min, same-stage native G in mg/dL and Gdot in mg/(dL min), current Z, host Sb/h and frozen numeric parameters
source_contract.output: Z derivative in pmol/(kg min^2) and total pancreatic appearance Spo in pmol/(kg min)
source_contract.ownership: host initializes Z=Sb and portal P=Sb/gamma, owns portal transit/liver arrival and fixed SC replacement; no added basal, hidden mutable state, future glucose or additional portal state
source_contract.trust: trusted local single-file Python source; hash checking does not establish rights, purity or biological validity

conditions.initial_and_sc: Exact unchanged BC-008 basal/native initial state, matched initial plasma insulin and fixed SC schedule; gastric solid load at t=0, no announced meal, bolus, controller, pump or sensor
conditions.observer: One-way unchanged Polonsky forward C-peptide observation of total pancreatic Spo; inherited equimolar ratio 1, Q1=Sb/k3, Q2=k1*Q1/k2, zero delivered/eliminated ledgers, archived piecewise-linear forcing and Q1/volume concentration; no added basal/SC/hepatic factor/portal delay/molecular conversion/body-weight division
conditions.adaptation: Reject unsupported scenario, state, unit, grid, numerical protocol or runtime identity; never silently adapt

comparison.support: pairwise complete sources; each source must pass its entire unchanged child causal/observation/repeat workflow across both scenarios
comparison.common_controls: verified BC-008 reference and host_constant_basal glucose/insulin/C-peptide trajectories must agree exactly across accepted children; disagreement makes comparison fail and direct contrasts null with reason
comparison.grid: all exact 961 saved times from 0 through 240 min inclusive; no shortening, resampling, interpolation across unmatched grids or sample exclusion
comparison.direction: left minus right in configuration roster order for every unordered source pair
comparison.ineligible: null descriptive metrics with explicit complete-source, identity, condition, grid or control reason; retain full planned pair and source/scenario denominators
comparison.overall: all planned sources and common identity/control/grid checks must pass; accepted pairwise descriptions may remain when a separate source fails, but overall roster stays failed
comparison.interpretation: descriptive modeled trajectory separation only; no automatic winner, source tuning, biological ranking, accuracy score or pooled-scenario ranking

failure_policy: Never overwrite or overlap supplied input/reference/output directories. Preserve full ordered source/scenario roster, failed/interrupted/unattempted entries, child archives, stage/errors, commands/logs/exits and identities. Partial output or a completed scenario from a failed source cannot become accepted support.

verification.native: Unchanged complete M4-RESEARCHER/1 criteria, all eight causal cases plus eight repeats and six observation cases plus six repeats per source
verification.reference_and_controls: same verified BC-008 reference identity and exact common host/reference trajectory equality across accepted children
verification.implementation: two existing source structures, independent contrast arithmetic, identity/grid/control incompatibility rejection, complete failing roster, deadlines/interruption ownership and exact fresh-process repeat evidence
verification.reconstruction: byte-identical report.json, report.md and figure.svg from saved artifacts using only the standard library, unchanged child readers and no supplied source or numerical runtime execution
verification.historical: coordinator inventory outside source-hashed historical packages; unchanged single-source commands and old archive reconstruction

excluded: human observations, calibration or clinical predictive quality
source tuning, winner selection or biological model ranking
new secretion physiology, states, runtimes or empirical task
insulin dosing, insulin-need estimation, beta-cell mass or treatment benefit
full ultradian engine reproduction or continuous-source convergence below 0.25 min
proof of arbitrary callback purity, rights or independent researcher usability
completed M4 biological acceptance, P1 product acceptance or public release
